name: Courtesan
descr: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.

features.name: Searing Glance
features.text: When a PC within Close range makes a Presence Roll, you can **mark a Stress** to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. On the target's failure, they must mark 2 Stress and are _Vulnerable_ until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target's success, they must mark a Stress.
